{"id":2003220951,"question_id":2892,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 1 week","timestamp":1778782229,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2003220951/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Check if Array is Good","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool isGood(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        unordered_map<int , int>mp;\n\n        if(n & 1) return false;\n\n        for(auto it : nums) mp[it]++;\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            if(it.first != n-1) \n            {\n                if(it.second > 1) return false;\n            }\n            else \n            {\n                if(it.second != 2) return false;\n            }\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"check-if-array-is-good","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1997}
